trophies.name: Vice Got a Price!
trophies.guide: Earn the other 54 trophies and this one unlocks by itself. There is no online trophy and no DLC trophy, so everything sits in the single-player game. PowerPyx rates the whole platinum at 4/10 difficulty and about 200 hours, with the 100% completion checklist as the longest grind — so plan around that, not around this trophy.

trophies.name: A Long Road
trophies.guide: Open the 100% Completion Checklist under Progress > Stats after the story and work through it. PowerPyx stresses this is not a true 100%: most side quests are not needed, many collectibles count only partly, and you need 70 of 80 challenges. Progress made during the story already counts, and nothing on the checklist is missable — everything can be finished in free-roam after the story.

trophies.name: Cunning Stunts
trophies.guide: Complete any 250 stunts out of 397 in the game. The four kinds are stunt jumps (130), flying under bridges (202), knife flights (40) and base jumps (25), and you can mix them freely. trophies.name: Gunslinger
trophies.description: Take down 5 enemies in a single use of Combat Focus.
trophies.guide: Take down 5 enemies in a single use of Combat Focus — activate it with L3+R3 while aiming. It slows time and drains the purple focus bar, so buff focus first with food, drinks or a shower at home, and use Adrenaline to stretch it. Line up gang members at an illegal operation and use an accurate full-auto rifle; PowerPyx notes it does not seem to work on soldiers, police or civilians. Focus levels up through shooting ranges, golf, pool, fishing and headshots, so it gets easier late in the game.

trophies.name: Maximum Withdrawal
trophies.guide: Rob any 5 bank vaults and escape. First finish the Chapter 4 optional mission That's Where The Money Is… (Wait at the Cafe), which introduces vault robberies: tail a security van to a bank, slip in while the vault is open, and bring your partner to carry a second bag. After that, buy security-van tips from Yasmani for $10,000 a tip. Robbing a vault instantly gives a 4-star wanted level, so escape on a fast motorcycle. There are 8 large bank jobs in total and 100% needs all 8, so this trophy comes on the way.

trophies.name: Actions Speak Louder
trophies.guide: Perform 500 actions that affect your criminal profile — the PSN tracker counts to 500. Turn on criminal-profile notifications under Settings > UI > HUD Notifications so a demon-face icon shows whenever an action counts. Robberies, clean escapes, stealth objectives and enemy encounters all count, so it builds passively; if it is your last trophy, aggressive play against police and civilians fills it fastest, at the cost of cops shooting on sight at high profile levels.

trophies.name: Dime on the Dollar
trophies.description: Earn $250,000 laundering Marked Bills through your contacts.
trophies.guide: Launder $250,000 of Marked Bills through your contacts, counted across all robberies — not in one trip. First finish the Chapter 3 mission Credit Check (Meet Raul's Crew), which unlocks the Dye Pack Jammer for laundering marked bills. Then rob banks and Payday Loans and bring the bills to a fence — Yasmani in Vice City pays the most. Bank vaults pay up to $205,000 in a single robbery, so this fills fast in the endgame.

trophies.name: Little Boxes
trophies.guide: Buy all 8 purchasable garages — there are also 4 story garages, which do not count. They cost $160,000 in total and are bought through the Vice City Real Estate phone app, unlocked after the Chapter 2 mission Daily Driver. Each garage adds one parking spot for registered vehicles, which the Scooter Bros trophy also needs.

trophies.name: On the Spot
trophies.description: Register 10 vehicles to the Scooter Bros app.
trophies.guide: Register 10 vehicles in the Scooter Bros app. The app arrives after the Chapter 2 mission Moses (Take A Vehicle to Moses); drive stolen vehicles to Moses in Port Gellhorn and choose Respray then Register in his garage. You need enough garage parking spots first, so buy garages before you start. At first Moses only takes vehicles without trackers; from Chapter 3, cars with standard trackers can be registered at any Pay 'n' Spray. Cheap low-end cars and bikes keep the fees down.

roadmap.title: Stage 1 — Play the story (Chapters 1-5)
roadmap.note: Main missions only. Do the Chapter 1 meditation at Jason's house while you can (see Positive Mental Attitude). Keep a separate save at the start of each chapter — there is no mission replay. Cheats disable trophies and saving, so leave them off.

roadmap.title: Stage 2 — Side-mission finales
roadmap.note: Finish the optional questlines for Andy, Kenton, Billy, Randy, Tyrone and Bret, plus 8 qualifying Strangers & Freaks strands. Every trophy-related quest giver returns after the story, so nothing here is missable.

roadmap.title: Stage 3 — Collectibles & exploration
roadmap.note: Cards (3 of 18 sets), WAiNK scans (100), vehicles (100 discovered), full map unfog, garages (8), and all 18 meditation spots. Start scanning and collecting during the story — progress already counts.

roadmap.title: Stage 4 — Activities, crime & cleanup
roadmap.note: Stunts (250), shooting ranges (42 golds), drone races (14), races (20), challenges (50 of 80), robberies, vaults, gang operations and the miscellaneous trophies. Most of these feed the 100% checklist.

roadmap.title: Stage 5 — 100% completion & platinum
roadmap.note: Open the 100% checklist under Progress > Stats after the story. It is closer to 60% true completion — 70 of 80 challenges, partial collectibles — and everything on it is doable in free-roam. Finish it and the platinum pops.
